game_concept: A tower defense set in Mystic Forest – Firefly Meadow, a meadow of fireflies: the beast tamer must handle thorn goblins while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Range Runner: Run a for i in range(n) loop so the beast tamer moves exactly n steps toward the elder's door.
theme: Mystic Forest – Firefly Meadow: a meadow of fireflies
core_gameplay_loop: In Firefly Meadow, repeat each round: Run a for i in range(n) loop so the beast tamer moves exactly n steps toward the elder's door. Each round, thorn goblins strike the elder's door, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the steps_left value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the elder's door from thorn goblins in Firefly Meadow: keep the steps_left meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: steps_left drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 3 (intro tier): Range Runner
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Range Runner' (Week 5 slot 1), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Firefly Meadow'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how steps_left changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against thorn goblins in Firefly Meadow.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 36 seconds while steps_left > 0.
